## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender young woman with expressive gray-green eyes, a sharp, delicate face, and a distinctively shaped nose. Her hair, which she cropped short in her youth after a disastrous hair-dyeing incident, grew back into a rich, wavy auburn. Known for her natural grace and unstudied style, she dresses simply yet tastefully.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c15 P14](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0014), [v1 c20 P4](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0004), [v1 c27 P36](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0036), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v3 c33 P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 c33 P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018), [v3 c37 P12](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0012), [v4 c8 P18](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0018)_

## Personality

Imaginative and loquacious, Nell constantly renames places and constructs romantic scenarios to escape dull realities. She possesses a fiery temper when mocked—particularly regarding her hair—yet she is deeply empathetic, loyal, and quick to repent. Passionate about beauty and literature, she approaches both joys and sorrows with intense emotional energy, striving to meet high moral ideals.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P26](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0026), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c4 P3](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0003), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c7 P15](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0015), [v3 c14 P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029)_

## History

Brought to St. Brendan's Island by mistake instead of an orphan boy, Nell was taken in by the bashful siblings Obed and Thirza Abernethy at Grey Shutters. Though initially unwanted due to her gender, her bright spirit and vivid imagination quickly won over both siblings, as well as her lifelong bosom friend Isolde Pembroke and neighbor Agatha Sowerby. Attending Brierley school, Nell excelled academically while engaging in a fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow, though she briefly boycotted school after breaking a slate over his head for calling her 'Carrots.' She formed a story club, organized the Brierley Village Improvement Society, and saved the life of little Posy Fay Pembroke during an attack of croup. Winning the prestigious Avery Scholarship at Regent's Academy, she chose to delay college to teach at Brierley school and support Thirza at Grey Shutters after Obed's sudden death. Later, Nell earned her B.A. with High Honors in English at Wexcombe College while living with friends at 'Tabby's Place.' Returning to Brierley to teach, she eventually reconciled her feelings for Hugh Carrow, agreeing to marry him. Following their wedding, they moved to a seaside cottage in Seven Gulls Harbor. Nell suffered the tragic loss of her firstborn daughter, Joyce, shortly after birth, but eventually found solace and joy in raising her second child, James Obed (Little Kit).

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c18 P33](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0033), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c37 P22](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0022), [v3 c38 P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P19](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0019), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v4 c19 P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 c19 P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 c34 P3](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0003), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia, to High School teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, who both died of fever when she was three months old.  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, helping care for four younger children.  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived upriver in a desolate clearing with Mrs. Rudge for over two years, minding eight children, including three consecutive sets of twins.  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum before being brought to St. Brendan's Island.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
